en.headline: Tourism chief confident visitor arrivals can exceed 55 million this year
en.dek: Rosanna Law said Hong Kong recorded more than 45.8 million arrivals in the first 10 months, a 12 percent rise, and expects the full-year total to top the original 53.8 million target.
body: The Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism, Rosanna Law, said on Saturday she was confident Hong Kong’s full-year visitor arrivals could surpass 55 million, after the city recorded more than 45.8 million arrivals in the first 10 months of 2026.

Speaking on a Commercial Radio programme, Law noted that the original government projection had been 53.8 million arrivals, representing about 8 percent growth. The actual year-on-year increase so far stands at 12 percent, and she pointed to the traditionally busy months of November and December as further support for exceeding the target.

Law also highlighted strong hotel performance linked to recent international meetings, including the APEC Finance Ministers’ Meeting in Hong Kong and the leaders’ summit in Shenzhen. Several hotels in Tsim Sha Tsui East reported occupancy rates of 92 to 93 percent when rooms were reasonably priced.

She said service attitudes in the tourism and catering sectors had improved since the pandemic and urged the trade to maintain regular programming to encourage repeat visits. The minister added that large international conferences help counter negative perceptions of the city, noting that finance ministers would not attend if Hong Kong were unsafe.

zh.headline: 羅淑佩料全年訪港旅客可突破5500萬人次
zh.dek: 文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩表示，今年首十個月錄得逾4580萬人次訪港旅客，按年升12%，有信心全年可超過原先5380萬目標。
body: 文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩今日表示，對本港全年訪港旅客人次可突破5500萬有一定信心。她指今年首十個月已錄得逾4580萬人次，按年增長12%。
羅淑佩在電台節目中指出，政府原先估算全年旅客為5380萬人次，按年約升8%。現時升幅已達12%，加上十一月及十二月向來是傳統旺季，有助超過原定目標。
她提到近期國際會議帶動酒店住宿理想，包括早前在港舉行的APEC財長會及深圳的領導人會議。尖沙咀東數間酒店入住率達92%至93%，只要房價合理，訪客願意入住。
羅淑佩說，經歷疫情後旅遊及餐飲業服務態度明顯改善，期望業界能細水長流，吸引旅客重遊。她亦指大型國際會議有助澄清外界對香港安全的誤解，若不安全，財長不會來港。
